description: Labelled architecture findings (M5-01). Keys are the fingerprint inputs of AR-09 (rule, from, to, edge type), never line numbers. kind "allowed" and "none" rows are negatives: any finding reported for them is a false positive. A row with "native" is labelled for the default configuration; "native" gives its kind, rule and (where they differ) edge types when visibility.nativeMarkers is true. "edgeTypes", where given, lists every edge type that carries the dependency; "edgeType" is the one the scorer matches (M5-11). M5-24: a row whose "to" names "external" ("<ecosystem>:<name>", as npm:pg) is a dependency on something outside the workspace (src/arch/elements.ts): the existing apps' rows on every external package their layered code uses were derived from expected-externals.json by the granularity rules as uncovered; since D039 (M5-24-R4) they are "none" rows, as those configurations have no package selector and no policy.uncovered.externals, so packages are out of scope (built-ins are not reported either); the ts-vendor, python-vendor, php-vendor and go-vendor apps confine a package to the layer that may use it (a package selector) and deny an overlay of dev-only packages.
